basis: Completed fixed paired sensitivity20 matrix (4320 races); no partial outcomes used. Primary and mixed responses favor modest Grok speed reduction plus recovery increase, not a handling nerf.
knownExtrapolations: Grok joint response is not assumed additive. GLM companion speed/launch changes and Whale speed compensation are unmeasured interactions. A Claude-lowest-speed alternative was considered but deferred because it requires a much larger unmeasured three-point speed reduction. All are globally applied roster coefficients; no map-specific bonuses.
decision: Assess only after full fixed screen. If direction is promising, extend the same exact source/profile training cohort to32primary/8mixed blocks per map by running only missing blocks. Screening is not independent confirmation. Do not open holdout before full training review and source freeze.
